title: Pick the home page structure
question: The look stays the coming-soon world: blue, white, Anton, Roboto Mono, white wipe bars. These three are different ways to lay out the home page. Lock one, steer it, or re-roll.

options.label: Name as the frame
options.lineage: the one-screen coming-soon page, grown up
options.thesis: MYKEY across the top, NISHIKAWA across the bottom, and all your work held in the band between them.
options.viewport: Desktop is one screen like the coming-soon page: MYKEY top-left with the menu beside it, Projects and Writing indexes side by side in the middle band, NISHIKAWA spanning the bottom edge.
options.risk: The band fits about four rows per list; on phones the frame has to become a stack.

options.label: One ledger
options.thesis: Everything you make and write in one numbered ledger, newest first, right under your name.
options.viewport: Your name spans the width; the ledger starts at the fold with No., Year, Kind, Title columns and All / Projects / Research / Notes filters.
options.risk: With only a few entries at launch the ledger looks short; it gets better the more you ship.

options.label: Spec sheet
options.lineage: a product spec card, about a person
options.thesis: Your name as the specimen, then a short mono table where every row is a fact or a door into a section.
options.viewport: Your name spans the width; below it a table: Based in, Does, Projects 03, Research 02, Notes 04, Visitors, Contact. Count rows open their index pages.
options.risk: The home shows no project titles, so visitors need one more click to see actual work.
